content.bridge_context: We explore how small identical shapes can cover a surface without gaps—this is called Tiling or Tessellation.

units.title: Tiling Patterns
units.explanation: A tiling pattern uses shapes that fit together perfectly, like bricks in a wall or tiles on a floor.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify tiling shapes. / टाइलिंग आकृतियों की पहचान करें।

units.title: Area through Tiling
units.explanation: The area of a surface is the number of unit squares (or tiles) needed to cover it completely.
units.dual_language_instruction: Count the tiles to find area. / क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात करने के लिए टाइलें गिनें।
